quarterly_data.signal: Product launch: NEC is enhancing its Obbligato series of product lifecycle management (PLM) software; sales of the latest version, Obbligato R5 (built on a 'Monozukuri Master' of BOM / BOP master data that integrates five chains including engineering and supply chains, an upgrade-free platform architecture, a subscription model, AI functions and environmental-data linkage), are scheduled to begin in October 2026, priced from 5.8 million yen per month for 1,000 users, with a sales target of 100 companies over the next three years.
quarterly_data.figure: launch October 2026; from 5.8 million yen/month for 1,000 users; sales target 100 companies over three years
